title: Claude 5.5: What you need to know about Anthropic's AI models and chatbot
summary: Explore what makes Claude a powerhouse in enterprise AI and a favorite among professionals who need depth over breadth.
body_markdown: To learn which AI model your team should use, check out the[AutomationBench](https://zapier.com/benchmarks) leaderboard. AutomationBench is Zapier's open evaluation tool for measuring how well models handle real, complex business workflows.
